entry.text: SharePoint Online, AI Builder (Intent & Entity Handling), Power Fx
• Role   :  Power Automate/Apps Developer
Responsibilities:
• Designed and developed an AI-powered conversational chatbot using Copilot Studio, tailored for internal
employee support use cases.
• Deployed and configured the chatbot within Microsoft Teams, enabling seamless access through employee
workspaces.
• Created intents, topics, entities, and conversation flows to handle common employee queries such as
requests, approvals, and status tracking.
• Integrated the chatbot with Power Automate workflows to trigger backend business processes and approval
mechanisms.
• Implemented adaptive cards in Microsoft Teams for rich user interactions, request submissions, and real-
time status updates.
• Built Power Automate approval flows to route employee requests to respective approvers and notify users
upon completion.
• Connected chatbot workflows with Dataverse and SharePoint Online for secure data storage and retrieval.
• Configured Outlook email notifications and Teams alerts to keep stakeholders informed throughout the
process lifecycle.
• Applied AI capabilities to improve intent recognition and enhance chatbot response accuracy.
• Implemented role-based access and user context handling using Teams authentication.
• Performed unit testing, UAT support, and production deployment, ensuring reliability and performance.
• Collaborated with business stakeholders to gather requirements and continuously enhance chatbot
capabilities.
• Reduced manual support effort by automating repetitive queries and improved response turnaround time
significantly.

• Role   :  Power App/Automate Developer
Responsibilities:

entry.text: Outlook Connector, SharePoint Online, AI Builder (Intent & Entity Handling), Power Fx
• Role   :  Power App/Automate Developer
Responsibilities:
• Designed and developed Power Automate automated flows triggered by incoming Outlook emails based on
specific conditions (sender, subject, keywords, priority).
• Integrated AI Builder and Copilot AI capabilities to summarize email content, extract key points, and
identify intent or request type.
• Implemented email classification logic to route requests to appropriate Teams channels or stakeholders.
• Built Teams notifications and adaptive cards to post summarized email insights for faster review and
decision-making.
• Automated creation of tasks, approvals, or follow-up actions based on extracted email information.
• Stored summarized data and metadata in Dataverse / SharePoint Online for tracking, auditing, and
reporting.
• Configured exception handling, retries, and logging mechanisms to ensure reliable automation.
• Optimized flow performance by reducing unnecessary actions and implementing parallel branches where
applicable.
• Collaborated with business users to fine-tune summarization rules and improve accuracy.
• Conducted testing, UAT support, deployment, and post-production monitoring of automation workflows.
• Ensured data security and compliance while handling email content and user information.
• Significantly reduced manual effort required to read and process high-volume emails.
• Improved response time by delivering actionable summaries directly to Microsoft Teams.
• Enhanced operational efficiency through AI-driven email processing and automation.
